name: Blue Blood ring
description: Deal low heal after turn. Ring made with heart of Blue Mage, creator of BLue heart spell

name: Heart ring
description: Increase maximum health. One of the first magical rings, created as gift with enough power to affect on Mages

name: Shiny ring
description: Increase maximum mana. Ring which contains dawn light, was first ring created with calculated effect

name: Scaly ring
description: Increase defence. Created with scales of draconic creature, one of the slayers to protect from next ones

name: Thorn ring
description: Deal damage after turn, but increase defence much Ring with small thorns on it. Created out of despair by the one of the oldest Mages to fight with slayers, but which need blood to continue work

name: Light ring
description: Regenerate additional mana after turn. Ring which absorbed one of the slayers light inside. This power slowly release in Mage who wears it, no one know it's limits

name: Fragile ring
description: Give one more chance. Once equipped, unequippable until mission will be ended. Regular ring on first look but any mage will feel it's power of ones who didn't survive the Slayers, their rage, their Hope

name: Glass ring
description: Increase damage and status but lowers maximum health much. Created by the selfish Mage who were sure that with enough power he wont get even one hit. The First Slayer destroyed him after dodging that Mage Attacks

name: Unstable ring
description: After trun increase or decrease health. Ring without only form. Were regular weak ring until Slayers tried to destroy it. It's power increased with ones who died in moment of release

name: Dice ring
description: Increase or decrease Mana after turn Six edged ring with numbers on it. Made by gambler mage when he lost all his money in game

name: Revengeance ring
description: Slightly increase all parameters Personal ring of Last Mage, created with his blood

name: Ring of memories
description: Increase status dealt with attacks. Ring with last words of best slayers. First it had low effect but with each new word it became stronger and stronger, filled with past of the bests. Looks like it were owned by one of Guardian relatives, one of the slayers

name: Ring of arms
description: Add chance to attack twice. A ring woven from red metallic arms, a deal Witch made to cheat the Death, the reason of her madness, but on Mage finger it works different

name: Clockwork ring
description: Increase direct damage. Old mechanism which springs and gears still work like in day they were created. Clock in perfect rhytm, like the machine it were related to. First ring that work with mages but not made by them
